comparison.objective: Candidate installs and secures a rack rail; record releases a camera payload from a cam-clamped mount and places it on a pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs compliant paired-prong insertion, telescoping alignment, and fastening; record rotates a cam, clears retaining geometry, and supports a payload transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained structural installation; record requires cam release, mount clearance, pad placement, robot clearance, and 1 s pose stability.
comparison.reason: Installation versus cam-release/removal exercises different mechanisms and end states. Candidate numeric clearance and damage limits are not supplied.
